conversation_starters.title: Nearly La Parra, almost HemisFair: Durango Boulevard’s surprising history
conversation_starters.summary: Durango survived an attempted rebranding tied to HemisFair, the 1968 world's fair held in San Antonio, and was transformed from a short street on the West Side, just west of downtown, into a major boulevard before losing its name in 2011.
